candidates.description: Triggers when a user asks to create, update, delete, or doctor a buyer or stakeholder persona in a connected GTM workspace. Not for ICPs, teammate records, general persona advice, or managing the context repository itself.
candidates.rationale: Bare-core description with concise lifecycle triggers and neighboring artifact boundaries.

candidates.description: Triggers when a user asks to create, define, refine, update, delete, or doctor a buyer or stakeholder persona file in a connected GTM workspace, including choosing which organization owns it. Not for ICPs, teammate records, general persona advice, or creating, importing, deleting, or repairing the context repository itself.
candidates.rationale: Adds natural define/refine language, the ownership boundary, and explicit sibling and repository-level exclusions.

candidates.description: Triggers when the requested outcome is to add, revise, remove, or validate persona Markdown owned by an organization in an existing GTM workspace. Not for ICP files, teammate profiles, generic buyer-persona exercises, or context-repository setup and repair.
candidates.rationale: Frames discovery around the durable persona-file outcome while separating similar uses of persona language.
